text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered INC-2767009 — latency SLO burn (p95->p99) on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Alert window: 5m. p99 > 1.5s. Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/INC-2767009 Graph: https://dash.redwood.ai/graphs/2767009

morgan: Acked. I'm oncall for this slot, investigating traces + autoscaling.

carla: +1, see queue depth spike at frontend lb -> sidecar. Lots of queued requests, sidecar backpressure increasing.

morgan: Confirmed: autoscaling group asg-gg-rt-uw2 had 3x scale-in events starting ~5m ago, many warm instances terminating -> cold starts + tokenization latency. 503s from a few sidecar pods seen.

pranav: PD escalated to SEV3 automatically. Any quick fallback to reduce customer impact? Can we shift traffic to us-east-1 or enable a degraded routing policy?

jess: Product: are customers seeing errors or just slowness? Any effect on embeddings/streaming?

joe_support: Support seeing ~10 customer reports mentioning slow generation and timeouts in internal apps (mostly east-coast customers hitting west region). No major data loss, but user-facing latency.

morgan: Short mitigation plan: 1) disable scale-in policy on asg-gg-rt-uw2 2) add 4 reserved instances (force up) 3) shift 20% traffic for /v1/generate to us-east-1 backbone. Applying now.

morgan: Running commands:
```bash
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name asg-gg-rt-uw2 --min-size 6 --desired-capacity 8
redwoodctl traffic-shift --route /v1/generate --percent 20 --to-region us-east-1 --reason "hot tail latency mitigation"
```

incident-bot: Action logged: scale-in policy disabled by morgan. Desired capacity -> 8. Traffic-shift job started (job id ts-2767009-1). PD: https://pagerduty.com/INC-2767009/status

carla: After forcing capacity + traffic-shift, prefix cache hit rate slowly improving. Warmup makes p95 stable but p99 tail still elevated — likely due to remaining cold workers.

morgan: Observability update: p99 dropped from 2.3s -> 1.1s within 3 minutes of scaling and shift. p95 unaffected (~0.35s). Keeping spike watchers on.

jess: Can we craft a short customer-facing status update? "Investigating elevated latency in US-West for generation requests; mitigation in progress." I can post to status.redwood.ai if we agree.

joe_support: Draft posted to status: "Investigating elevated latency for text generation in US-West. Traffic rerouted and capacity increased while we investigate root cause. ETA 30m." Will monitor customer replies.

pranav: I'll take the handoff in 15m. Please leave any leftover runs (traffic-shift job id) and exact commands in the thread. If p99 rises above 1.2s again, escalate to SEV2 and we switch 50% traffic.

morgan: Copy. Job id ts-2767009-1. ASG change initiated. Keeping autoscaler disabled for now. Will document next steps in incident doc. :thumbsup:

carla: Noted — I'll follow up with infra to check why scale-in triggered aggressively during low CPU. Suspect a metrics regression in the scale policy or a bursty request pattern.

incident-bot: INC-2767009 status -> acknowledged by pr anav (oncall).

pranav: I have ack, monitoring dashboards now. If things stay green for 30m I'll start a short post-incident review and assign follow-ups for autoscaler policy and cache warmup.

joe_support: Customers updated. No new escalations in the last 10m.

morgan: p99 steady ~1.05s for last 5m, p95 ~0.33s. Closing active mitigation if stable. Turning autoscaler back on once warmup is complete and we've validated policy changes.

pranav: Handoff complete. I'll keep this as the live thread for follow-ups and RCA notes. Thanks team. :heart:

jess: Thanks — please add the customer-impact section to the incident doc (affected customers, complaint count, ETA for fix).

carla: Filing follow-up ticket INFRA-4823 for autoscaler policy investigation and runbook update.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2767009 — last state update: monitoring.
